footprint.source_crs: EPSG:4326; projected to EPSG:2968 for exact membership
footprint.project_local_xy: matches modular/AGENTS.md local geographic approximation; origin -86.9137, 40.4274

method.returns_inside_footprint: LAS returns whose XY are covered by the exact transformed GIS ring
method.ground_sample: Class 2 returns outside the ring within 10 m; median used as local datum
method.roof_candidate_filter: Class 1 returns at or above 650 ft NAVD88. Threshold is an analysis filter (>8.3 m above ground median), not a semantic roof classification.
method.roof_surface: Filtered unclassified surface returns indicate high central bands and depressed perimeter; vegetation and other objects cannot be fully excluded.

limits: No class-6 building returns were present within the ring; class 1 means unclassified.
The LiDAR supports surface heights and roof articulation, but does not independently identify wall lines, floors, or stories.
LiDAR point density, return classification, roof-edge trees, and local ground sample introduce uncertainty.
